summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a signed term sheet for $40 million in new senior secured credit facilities from a Big 5 Canadian bank, comprising a $25 million revolver and a $15 million delayed draw term loan. The facilities will refinance existing debt with connectFirst Credit Union and second-lien debentures. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is involved; this is a refinancing. The deal includes financial covenants (leverage ratios) and is subject to customary conditions with a 60-day expected close. This is a routine capital management event, not a special situation. What to watch: completion of definitive documentation and impact on cost of capital.
